title: Basketball Rush
desc: This isn’t just about shooting — it's about precision, patience and strategy. As you score, the game intensifies, but with helpful power-ups at your disposal, you’ll be ready for anything. Unlock a variety of unique ball skins to customize your game and add even more excitement.
howto: Drag and release the ball to aim and shoot it into the basket
The more baskets you score, the more difficult the game becomes!
Use power-ups to help you in challenging moments
Earn coins with every successful shot to unlock new ball skins
Keep playing to beat your high score and master the game!
tips: Pump fake first — most defenders bite on it.
Release at the top of the arc for the best accuracy.
